Name: Interaction Bubbles
Author: Owenynk112
Description:
[color=#900000][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][b]Main feature[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[font=Georgia][size=4]The Interaction Bubbles mod [/size][b][size=4][color=#6aa84f]adds 95 emote icons to the game[/color].[/size][/b][size=4] [/size]
[color=#ffe599][size=4][b]Villagers use them while chatting with each another or interacting with you[/b],[/size][/color][size=4] making the village feel more alive. [/size][/font]
[font=Georgia]
[b][size=5]For example, when you give someone a gift, they may show their appreciation—or their disgust! [/size][/b][/font]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51408/51408-1787936902-74674133.png[/img]
[size=5][font=Georgia][b]Villagers also openly express their feelings and share a little gossip. [/b][/font][/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51408/51408-1787936854-2032503377.png[/img]
[size=4][font=Georgia][size=4][b]At least Pierre will now enthusiastically ask you if you are willing to spend some money. Vincent, when will you finally start studying seriously?[/b][/size][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Georgia][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51408/51408-1787936854-203722339.png[/img][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Georgia]This mod is still in early development![/font][/size]

[color=#cc0000][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][b]Mechanism[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[size=4][font=Georgia]This mod does not rely on AI-generated. Instead, it uses locally candidate pools and randomized combinations of emotes. (hmm, professionally speaking, [color=#b6d7a8]this is character AI behavior[/color])[/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Georgia]I based these pools primarily on the vanilla characters’ personalities( such as [color=#ea9999]Teen, Rude, and Shy... [/color])and social relationships, and then manually curated and adjusted the available emotes candidates. [/font][/size]

[color=#cc0000][size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]
[size=4][font=Georgia]As mentioned above, creating detailed candidate pools for individual character and even adding their unique emotes,is quite time-consuming. [/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Georgia]Also, some mod authors may also prefer that their characters not perform certain behaviors. [/font][/size]
[font=Georgia][size=4]For these reasons, the early version [/size][color=#ffff00][size=4]only includes compatibility with SVE[/size][/color][size=4] and my mod [/size][color=#6aa84f][size=4]Wildroot Chronicles.[/size][/color][color=#e06666][size=3](This does not mean that you will be unable to start the game while enabling other mods. It simply means that characters from other mods will not use the bubbles.)[/size][/color][/font]

[font=Georgia][color=#cc4125][size=4][b]With the original authors’ permission and if I have enough time, I may add support for other mods in the future. [/b][/size][/color][/font]

[font=Georgia][color=#ffffff][size=4]If you select the[/size][/color][color=#e06666][size=4][b] Vanilla Pack[/b][/size][/color][color=#ffffff][size=4], only [/size][/color][color=#ffe599][size=4][b]vanilla characters[/b][/size][/color][color=#ffffff][size=4] will use these bubbles. However, it will still work with SVE’s modified maps and schedules. [/size][/color][/font]
[font=Georgia][color=#ffffff][size=4]If you select the [/size][/color][color=#e06666][size=4][b]Mod Pack[/b][/size][/color][size=4][color=#ffffff], characters [/color][b][color=#ffff00]from SVE and Wildroot Chronicles[/color][/b][color=#ffffff] will use the bubbles as well.[/color][/size][/font]

[font=Georgia][size=4][b][color=#ff0000]❤️ SPECIAL THANKS[/color]
[/b][/size][/font]
[left][font=Georgia][size=4][b][color=#ffffff]To the Stardew Valley modding community, the SMAPI team, the wiki contributors, and everyone who tried Interaction Bubbles early, reported bugs, or simply enjoys watching people chatting. [/color][color=#f4cccc]😊[/color][/b][/size][/font][/left]
